summary: Added wires_to param to record_decision MCP tool and /overlay/note POST handler. In lib/mcp-core.js: added wires_to (array of strings) to the inputSchema and forwarded it in the run call. In daemon.js (after the hint/supersede block, before T.save()): iterates b.wires_to and calls overlayStore.addEdge + graphStore.appendEvent for each task key, creating explicit context edges from the note to the specified tasks. Daemon restart required to pick up mcp-core.js changes.
